grandparents_cupboard.reason: Butter, eggs, feta, olive oil and fresh garden vegetables and herbs are all whole, everyday foods.

supermarket.reason: Little gems, radishes, spring onions, fresh peas in pods, feta, mint and lemons are all everyday supermarket buys in June.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded frying pan, a bowl and a knife, and a covered hob frittata is well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: Eight eggs with peas, lettuce and feta, cooked gently under a lid for 12 minutes, gives a set frittata for four, and the salty feta and lemon dressing keep it well seasoned.

honest_times.reason: Twenty-five minutes covers podding the peas, slicing the onions and radishes, shredding the lettuce and beating the eggs, and the 15 minutes of cooking matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, the little gems match the lettuce id, and nothing unlisted appears in the steps.

seasonal_feel.reason: Lettuce is both cooked into the frittata and served as the salad, which makes a fitting light lunch for the end of June.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, peas, feta and a fresh salad make a balanced, satisfying family lunch.
